:::{#exr-unbiased-mse}
#### Mean squared error of an unbiased estimator

Using @thm-mse-bias-variance,
write the [mean squared error](#def-mse) of an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) estimator $\hparam$
in terms of its variance.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-unbiased-mse}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mselr{\hparam}
&= \sqf{\bias{\hparam}} + \var{\hparam}
&& \text{(MSE equals bias squared plus variance)}\\
&= 0^2 + \var{\hparam}
&& \text{(definition of unbiased)}\\
&= \var{\hparam}
&& \text{($0^2 = 0$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
